newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bk of East Asia in HK$18 bln CD programme.
newsitem.headline: Bk of East Asia in HK$18 bln CD programme.

text.p: The Bank of East Asia said on Friday that it has signed a HK$18 billion floating rate certificate of deposit programme arranged by Societe Generale Asia.

The CD programme allows Bank of East Asia to issue through institutions appointed as dealers U.S. or Hong Kong dollar denominated fixed rate and floating rate issues with tenors of three months to five years and discounted CDs with tenors of three months to one year.

In addition to Societe Generale Asia, dealers for the programme are Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale Hong Kong branch, BZW Asia, China Development Finance Co (Hong Kong), Credit Lyonnais, Daiwa Securities (HK), LTCB Asia, Merrill Lynch International, Sakura Finance Asia, Sanwa International Finance, Schroders Asia, Sumitomo Finance (Asia), Union Bank of Switzerland Hong Kong branch, Westpac Banking Corp Hong Kong branch.
Bank of East Asia's first issue to be launched off this programme, a HK$2.3 billion FRCD due December 1999, also was signed today.
